title: Clearly Qualified for a Job?
description:
Keywords are not resume fluff. Keywords are the language a company is looking for and that you should be using to display how you’re qualified for the role. Grab these from the job description. Use them to inspire what achievements you add to your resume and how you display your value. #resume #resumetips #resumekeywords #resumebullets
